items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 在下行秋，不过书海一蠹。某虽不才，仍愿为君略尽绵薄。难得有机会说这种风格的台词，感觉还不错。
items.text_en: Xingqiu at your service, my liege! I humbly trust that even one such as I, a mere bookworm, may yet prove to be of some utility under your wise leadership. Nice, I don't often get a chance to speak with such formality. It felt pretty good!

items.title: 闲聊·无人夜
items.text: 「有时明月无人夜，独向昭潭制恶龙。」
items.text_en: 'Twas on a deserted moonlit night that the hero approached the vile dragon's limpid lair...

items.title: 闲聊·文章
items.text: 「衣裓贮文章，自言学雕虫。」
items.text_en: I never embark on a journey without a good book to accompany me.

items.title: 闲聊·偷闲
items.text: 正所谓「偷得浮生半日闲」，哈哈。
items.text_en: Now this is what I call, "a moment of solitude."

items.title: 闲聊·阅卷
items.text: 如此如此，这般这般…欸？欲知后事如何，且听下回分解？唔…
items.text_en: Oh my goodness... Oh my gosh... Wow— Huh? "All will be revealed in the next volume"? Aw, drat...

items.title: 闲聊·新书
items.text: 盘算着也该到「万文集舍」新进小说的日子了，不妨…我们顺道去看看？
items.text_en: If my calculations are correct, Wanwen Bookhouse is due to receive a batch of new releases today. Might we add a small detour to our adventure?

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 这么说来，我们家出品的锦缎伞，好像既不能遮阳也不能挡雨。唯一的用处就是挂在墙上。
items.text_en: My family makes ornate umbrellas that block neither rain nor shine. Their sole purpose is for decoration upon a wall.

items.title: 雨过天晴
items.text: 晴了就好，不然藏书会生霉的。
items.text_en: Good, the rain has stopped. Any longer and my books would have gotten wet.

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 只有这种天气的时候，我才会觉得家里比书店好。家里炭火很足，而书堆里就不准用火。
items.text_en: Only when it snows like this would I prefer to be at home than in a book store. For there is a well-stocked fireplace at home, while there is no fire allowed in book stores.

items.title: 阳光很好
items.text: 练功的好…啊不，是看书的好时节啊。好啦，我脸上又没有写字，别一直盯着我看了。
items.text_en: Great weather for practicing martial arts, but perfect weather for reading. Hey, what's that ridiculous look for? You look as if you're trying to decipher some strange text written on my forehead.

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 早啊。早上的时间这么难得，能做做自己喜欢的事情就好了。
items.text_en: Morning! The morn hours are precious. Spend them on that which matters to you.

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 午饭有点不想吃米饭，想吃糕点。待在书斋吃，父亲和兄长就不知道了…嗯？想一起来吗？嗯…只要你不把碎屑沾到书上就行。
items.text_en: I am uninclined to eat a heavy meal this luncheon, but instead indulge in some baked treats. As long as I eat in the study, my father and brother never have to know! Oh, you want to join me? Well... As long as you don't get crumbs on the books, I suppose it's fine.

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 去偷点萤火虫来看书，怎么样？唔，我的玩笑话你可别当真，对眼睛不好的。
items.text_en: What say you we snatch a few fireflies and read in the light they give? Hehe... Hey, I'm joking. Seriously, don't, it's bad for your eyesight.

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 明天我也在老地方。只要你不中途迷了路，就准能找得到我。
items.text_en: You will find me in the same place as ever tomorrow. So I'll see you then. Unless you manage to get lost on the way.

items.title: 关于行秋自己
items.text: 在人前彬彬有礼，是因为大家见我是飞云商会的二少爷；在你面前能这么轻松，大概因为你看我的方式并不一样吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3I always have to put on an act around other people, because they see me only as the second son of the Feiyun Commerce Guild. It's a relief that I can just be myself around you. I think it's because you don't see me in the same way.

items.title: 关于我们·书友
items.text: 你算是我的书友吧。什么？打架？古华派？战友？…唔！你都在说些什么呢。不是说好这是我们两人间的秘密吗！
items.text_en: I would say we are book buddies. Huh? Combat? Guhua Clan? Comrades in arms? ...What on earth are you talking about? I told you that's our little secret!

items.title: 关于我们·结拜
items.text: 我要和你结拜，就去绝云间的祭坛那边。不行，不能拒绝。你知道了我的底细，也就知道了一直被我掩饰着的真实的自己…我不能放你走。除非…你答应我不会撒手不干！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6We should become sworn siblings, let's go to the altar at Jueyun Karst. Nope, no ifs, no buts, you know too much about me! You know the real me, the one I normally have to hide. I simply can't let you go until you promise me you will go through with it!

items.title: 关于「神之眼」·古书
items.text: 「神之眼」的事情，虽然一般少有记载，但在我所收集的古书中却有一段特别的描述，待我找给你。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3There aren't many records on matters concerning Visions, but I do have a passage dedicated to the topic in my collection of ancient texts. I can lend it to you if you want.

items.title: 关于「神之眼」·领悟
items.text: 受书中启发，我领会到，枪术与剑术的本质，正是瞳术。唔，解释起来可能有点费力…如果你真想知道，就跟我去「王山厅」走一趟吧。事先声明，到时候你可不准笑。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5I've come to an epiphany based on some things I've been reading — ultimately, the arts of both the polearm and the sword are just the art of the "eye." Ugh, it's a little difficult to explain... If you want to know more, come with me to Wangshan Hall. But first, you have to promise me you won't laugh.

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 璃月非去不可的地方？这个问题很难回答，不过，如果消失了会让我很难过的地方…「万文集舍」稳排第一，「古华堂」能进前十吧。
items.text_en: Must-see places in Liyue? That's a tough question. Hmm... The place I would miss the most if it disappeared would be the Wanwen Bookhouse, first and foremost. The Guhua Sect would be in the top ten, too.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 以前是兔子，后来是鹿。对我来说，「请从绝处，读我侠义」是舍弃一切的觉悟，鹿却是绝处逢得新生的希望。真想再见它一次啊。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I used to like rabbits, but I'm more a fan of stags now. To me, the saying "May my final stand be a monument to chivalry" is about abandoning worldly possessions and reaching enlightenment. But the stag's final resting place represents the hope for life anew. Oh, how I'd love to see it again.

items.title: 关于北斗
items.text: 北斗阁下是我非常敬重的人。不过希望她不要喊我「小子」，也不要一见面就揉我头发。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I have great respect for Lady Beidou. I just wish she wouldn't call me "kid" and ruffle my hair each time she sees me.

items.title: 关于凝光
items.text: 「天权」大人是我不得不敬重的人。不然会给家父以及家兄添麻烦。嗯？对她本人，我想想。嗯…还是算了，不说人坏话了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4In her capacity as the Tianquan, I am obliged to respect her. Otherwise, it could create issues for my father and brother. On a personal level? Let me think... I think I will go with "No comment," I shan't speak ill of others.

items.title: 关于重云
items.text: 唉，重云这家伙，虽然也知道我的底细，但真要和他搭档去完成任务还得审慎。他现在还是执着「武」技，却不理解「侠」心的境界。需要多练练。尤其…是吃辣的方面，哈哈。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Ah, dear Chongyun. Though he understands me quite well, one has to exercise caution when teaming up with him to go on a quest. He is making good progress in the martial arts, but I would say he hasn't quite internalized the chivalric code yet... He needs more practice. Especially at eating spicy food...

items.title: 关于云堇
items.text: 云堇啊，她只要能喝到满意的饮品，就会有动力去创作新戏。我呢，就一直在床底下囤着一小罐茶叶，就是为了等哪天她兴致索然的时候给她送去。这样，我就有听不完的异侠传奇了！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4When Yun Jin drinks a beverage she is fond of, she will be inspired to write a new play. So, I keep a jar of tea leaves under my bed at all times, ready to deliver to her on the day that her inspiration dries up. This way, I shall never run out of heroic tales to listen to!

items.title: 关于胡桃
items.text: 那个小姑娘，正是「往生堂」的当代堂主。嗯？问我怎样看待她的为人？…行事作风嘛，坊间传闻是作不了数的。真想了解一个人，还得看她真正想要的是什么。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Ah yes, the young lady who is now the Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. If you're asking what I think about her as a person... Well, there are all sorts of rumors about the way she works. But I think if you really want to understand someone, you need to find out what they are really after.

items.title: 关于七七
items.text: 总感觉七七的身上藏着谜团。但只要白术先生在场，就跟她说不上几句话。除非，我们能找个白术先生外出看诊的机会，专门…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I've always thought there is more to Qiqi than meets the eye. But it's impossible to have a conversation with her when Baizhu's around. Hmm... We could wait till Baizhu makes a home call to one of his other patients and corner her...

items.title: 关于香菱
items.text: 见到香菱的时候，你可得多观察一下她的表情。尤其是刚刚添置完食材回来的香菱，笑得越开心，就越危险。要是被她缠上、逼你试吃新品…这种情况，我一般会靠重云来处理。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4When you first spot Xiangling out and about, the first thing you should do is check the look on her face. Especially when she's just coming back from collecting new ingredients — the more excited she looks, the more dangerous it is to approach. Because if she sees you, she'll force you to taste-test her latest concoction... I usually get Chongyun to handle these situations, hehe...

items.title: 关于辛焱
items.text: 辛焱到底是在哪里演出的？从吃虎岩到玉京台，哪里都躲不过那种鸡飞狗跳的穿透力…唉，能够安静看书的时日是多么宝贵啊。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Where does Xinyan perform? Anywhere from Chihu Rock to Yujing Terrace — no spot is untouched by her disruptive presence... A quiet day when I can curl up with a good book is a rare treasure indeed.

items.title: 关于阿贝多
items.text: 下一卷、下下卷、下下下卷的重要场景，我都已经想好要配怎样的插画了！啊，必须赶快把灵感记下来，修书一封，寄给白垩老师…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6I've thought of all the illustrations I want for each major event in the next three volumes! I should write my thoughts down before I forget them, and send them to Mr. Kreideprinz...

items.title: 关于钟离
items.text: 我看见过家父和家兄接待这位先生，就从他们行礼时候的恭敬态度来看…对方应该是很有地位的人物吧。我还听说他是给仙人办丧事的人，感觉很有底蕴。要不要一起去挖掘他身上的秘密呢？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Farwell, Archaic Lord"My father and brother entertained that gentleman as a guest once. From the way they were acting, he must be a very high-profile figure indeed. I also heard that he directs funerals for the adepti, so he must surely have great depth to his character. We should do some digging and see what we can find out about him!

items.title: 关于申鹤
items.text: 总觉得申鹤小姐看我的眼神里略显凶恶，让我不敢随便跟她搭话。奇怪，难道我无意中得罪过她吗？或者…得罪过她身边的人？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I find that Miss Shenhe seems to look at me somewhat fiercely, so I daren't approach her lightly. Bizarre, did I inadvertently upset her? Or maybe... upset someone close to her?

items.title: 关于夜兰
items.text: 你听说过「一人千面」这个词语吗？夜兰小姐就给我这种感觉。上门来访的时候，家父和家兄以礼相待，她也还之以礼，就像是个亲切稳重的大姐姐。可在别的地方见到她时，又完全是不同的印象。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Have you heard the expression "same person, different face"? Ms. Yelan gives me precisely this feeling. When she came to visit my family, my father and brother treated her with respect, and she was pleasant and polite in return. She seemed like a kind and mature young lady to me. But when I saw her elsewhere, she gave a completely different impression.

items.title: 关于嘉明
items.text: 嘉明的工作颇有侠之风范。 试想，功夫盖世的黑衣少年携手威武镇煞的瑞兽，在月黑风高夜，将盗贼与恶徒打得落花流水，狼狈而逃…等他得空，真想听他多分享一些走镖路 途中的见闻。 你也一起来吧？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Gaming's work has all the trappings of a chivalric hero. Picture the scene — on a dark and moonless night, a lone young figure clad in black stands fearless on a secluded country road. They say his mastery of the martial arts is unparalleled, and the mythical beast by his side always does his bidding... Bandits and brigands beware, for none who challenge him come away unscathed... When he has the time, I'd love to hear more about his experiences as a guard. You should come along too.

items.title: 想要了解行秋·其一
items.text: 阁下近来可好？如果闲来无事，可以来「万文集舍」转转。
items.text_en: Are you keeping well, my liege? If you have no other matters to attend to, might I recommend a trip to the Wanwen Bookhouse?

items.title: 想要了解行秋·其二
items.text: 问我为什么总是一个人看书？好学…并不是什么坏习惯吧。没有什么特别的地方，嗯，真的没有。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3You ask why I enjoy reading in solitude? ...Studiousness can hardly be considered a bad habit. There's not much more to it than that. Really.

items.title: 想要了解行秋·其三
items.text: 今天的时间已经空出来了吗？好，我也随时可以出发。书？没关系，书可以回来接着看，那些需要我们帮助的人可不能等啊。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Your schedule is free today? Wonderful. I am ready to leave whenever you are. ...My book? Oh, never mind that! I can always pick up where I left off when I get back. But those in distress who need our assistance cannot afford to wait.

items.title: 想要了解行秋·其四
items.text: 你说你有个好点子？用我们之前做的事情当原型，写一本探案集加武侠题材的小说，《万文集事件簿》？嗯，啊哈哈哈…是个好点子，但是不采纳。嗯，不会采纳的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5You feel inspired, you say? You want to write a martial arts detective novel based on our adventures together? And you want to call it the "Chronicles of Wanwen"? Hahaha... It's a good idea, it really is. But I'll have to decline, I'm sorry. Yes, really...

items.title: 想要了解行秋·其五
items.text: 「洋洋万言，织诗成锦。」唉，我也想有这样的评价啊。这件事我只和你一个人说。其实，我也在写小说。现、现在当然不能给你看，以后…以后你会在书店里看到的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6"A weaver of verses who draws from an ocean of expression..." That's the reputation I aspire to. But you're the only person I can share that with. I am actually writing a novel... but I can't let you see it. Not yet. The time will come, though... You'll be able to read it when it's on sale in book stores all over Liyue.

items.title: 行秋的爱好
items.text: 我的爱好自然是看书。什么书都会看。嗯？你一脸坏笑看着我干什么。唔，那事我们两个知道就行了，还是不适合明面上讲。说出来就没意思了。
items.text_en: Evidently, my hobby is reading. I'll read anything and everything. ...What's that mischievous grin for? Oh. That's between the two of us, okay? It's not appropriate to discuss it out loud. There's no point in bringing it up anyway.

items.title: 行秋的烦恼
items.text: 烦恼啊，嗯…未来有朝一日兄长继承了家业，我会怎么样呢？这样无忧无虑的生活恐怕…啊，我不是在说身份之类的，我不在乎那些。我是觉得大哥太呆了，没我帮忙不太行啊。
items.text_en: What annoys me? Hmm... Well, one day my brother will inherit the family business. What will happen to me then? I fear my current carefree existence would... Oh — no no no, it's not about my status or anything like that. I don't care for that kind of thing. I just think my brother is something of a simpleton and I would probably end up having to do most of his job for him...

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 我比较喜欢吃糕点和月菜海鲜。主要是因为，我们家一直就吃得很清淡吧。
items.text_en: I like baked goods and Yue-style seafood. Probably because I'm used to quite a bland diet at home.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 我很讨厌胡萝卜，小时候家母经常捣碎胡萝卜做成…还是不要让我讲下去了。即使是在回忆里，那种味道也…
items.text_en: I hate carrots. When I was young, my mother would mash them up into... Ugh, I can't go on. Just thinking about it makes me feel sick...

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 此等美食，吃过一次就再难忘怀了啊。
items.text_en: I need only sample this delight but once for its aroma to remain forever in my memory.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 既然你有这份手艺，不如我们开个路边餐馆，如何？
items.text_en: With cooking skills as good as yours, it'd be a waste not to open a restaurant, wouldn't you agree?

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 你吃你吃，不必客气。
items.text_en: I couldn't possibly. But please, you eat your fill. I insist.

items.title: 生日·祝福
items.text: 咳，咳咳。恭祝你福寿与天齐，庆贺你生辰快乐。
items.text_en: May this day of your birth be filled with much mirth!

items.title: 生日·习俗
items.text: 据记载，天成石桥是上古战争时候，岩之神摩拉克斯投出的石枪倒塌后形成的。要是生日当天在桥上走一趟，往两边海里投点摩拉，就能保佑一年安康…生日一年只有一次，想去的话就快点去吧…没骗你，是真的。真的，快去吧。
items.text_en: According to historical records, Tiancheng's stone bridge was formed by a fallen rock spear thrown by the Geo Archon Morax in battle. If you walk along the bridge on your birthday and throw some Mora into the sea from both sides, you will be blessed in the coming year... Your birthday only comes once a year, so be quick about it if you wanna go... I'm not kidding, it's true! Go try it and you'll see!

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 如果没有能力，那我心中的那个字，可能也就停在纸面上了吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1Were it not for my capability, the cause that so inspires me would remain confined to the pages that extol its virtues.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 如果心中没有善恶的标尺，努力就会错了方向。舍本逐末，变成追逐暴力的俗人。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2Had I no moral compass, my efforts would have been misguided. Doomed to grasp at shadows while missing the substance, I would have become a philistine that seeks only violence.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 我所追求的那个字，在璃月这方土地上并非处处通行。不过行道至此，我对这一点早就有了足够的认识。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4There is a cause that I seek to champion, yet few in Liyue share my aspiration. This I have known for a long time, for it is a path I have walked for many years.

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 多亏了你的陪伴。我对自己也很满意了——无论是武学，还是对那个字的理解。唉，算啦。我也不用对「侠」字讳莫如深了。我的「侠」，父亲和兄长应该也不会质疑了。只不过嘛，低调行事这点还是得保留的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6I am most grateful for your company on my journey. I am proud of my achievements, both in the martial arts and in championing the cause so dear to my heart. ...Ah, I guess there's no need to euphemize any longer. Chivalry! That is the cause that inspires me, and that I seek to champion. Why should I shy away from it, I am sure my father and brother are under no illusion as to what I stand for by now. ...But of course, I still need to be somewhat discreet in the way I go about my business.

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 雨线难画。
items.text_en: Rain outlines your fate!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text_en: Ha... Hmph!

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 断！
items.text_en: Know my sword!

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 古华深秘。
items.text_en: Witness the power of Guhua!

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 织诗成锦。
items.text_en: Let me weave you a verse.

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 裁雨留虹。
items.text_en: Raincutter!

items.title: 冲刺开始·其一
items.text: 形随神至。
items.text_en: Body and mind.

items.title: 冲刺开始·其二
items.text: 该行动了。
items.text_en: Time to act.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 甚好甚好。
items.text_en: Excellent.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 寻得珍宝，真是充满侠义的经历。
items.text_en: Treasure-hunting... A valiant endeavor.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 倘若还有几卷失传的古书，就完满了。
items.text_en: I hope we find long-lost ancient literature.

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 计划有变…
items.text_en: Change of plans...

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 接下来就不再是「点到为止」了。
items.text_en: I can no longer hold back.

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 「请从绝处，读我侠义。」
items.text_en: May my final stand be a monument to chivalry.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 过来这边，我有一计。
items.text_en: Come. I have devised a plan.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 小心行事为好。
items.text_en: Tread carefully.

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 承蒙…赐教…
items.text_en: I have taught you... everything... I know...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 灯华易散…我是知道的。
items.text_en: The brightest flames... burn fastest...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 失手了…
items.text_en: I am outplayed...

items.title: 普通受击·其一
items.text: 不妨事。
items.text_en: A minor setback.

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 大意了。
items.text_en: I let my guard down.

items.title: 重受击·其二
items.text: 不好…
items.text_en: Not good...

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 厚积而薄发。
items.text_en: May knowledge guide you.

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 不惭世上英。
items.text_en: Chivalry will never die.

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 扶善惩恶，当仁不让。
items.text_en: For justice.
